title: 재외공관 무관주재령 / queue:ADDENDUM:35948:20251230:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 35948, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That amendments to Presidential Decrees under Article 4 of these Addenda that were promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but have not yet entered into force shall take effect on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (44) Omitted.

(45) Part of the Decree on Military Attachés Stationed at Diplomatic Missions Abroad shall be amended as follows:

In Article 10 (1), "Minister of Economy and Finance and Minister of Foreign Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Minister of Planning and Budget".

(46) through (176) Omitted.
